name: Mixed Add-On Playground
description: A Runner with its own HUD and a Pulse Carbine, a Dune Buggy, Blockhead Bots, Stompers and Fizzers, all from separate Add-Ons. Build a fort, drive through it, fight the bots. Type /trooper to become the heavy Trooper with its own camera, and /blockhead for a plain Blockhead. Respawning brings the Runner back.
